title: How the World Reacted to Harry Kane’s 2026 Ballon d’Or Win
subtitle: SI
paragraphs: By Roberto Casillas8:00 AM EDTHarry Kane took home the first Ballon d’Or of his brilliant career.  / Jeff Spicer/UEFA/Getty ImagesThe eyes of the entire soccer world were firmly focused on the 2026 Ballon d’Or awards on Monday night, with millions sharing their thoughts on social media throughout the ceremony.

The most prestigious award of the night went to England and Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane, who was recognized as the best player in the world with the first Ballon d’Or triumph of his career. At the same time, Alexia Putellas took home the third Women’s Ballon d’Or of her career, going level with former Barcelona teammate Aitana Bonmatí as the most successful women’s player in Ballon d’Or history.
Many other men’s and women's stars were recognized with other prestigious awards across various categories throughout the evening.
The annual Ballon d’Or award gala has become soccer’s most glamorous event; a night full of glitz, glamor and pageantry that celebrated the best of the best in the sport.

Current and former players, soccer figures and fans all over the world took to social media to react to the as the 2026 Ballon d’Or awards unfolded, adding to the folklore of the most prestigious award ceremony event in soccer.

Harry Kane experienced all the emotions after winning the 2026 Ballon d’Or.  / Franck Fife/AFP/Getty ImagesHarry Kane wins 2026 Ballon d’OrIt took longer than expected but eventually we reached the most awaited moment of the Ballon d’Or ceremony. Then, appropriately, 33-year-old Kane took home the most prestigious individual award in the sport, winning the 2026 Ballon d’Or award—the first of his career.
After months of speculation and public campaigning—especially from podium finishers Kylian Mbappé and Lamine Yamal—it was Kane who added his name to the list of legendary Ballon d’Or winners.
